purpose: Frozen manual routing evaluation; created after inspecting implementation, before executing these queries. Not an independently annotated or hidden benchmark.
label_policy: Clarify when a personalized decision lacks the debt kind, requested bank/rank, numeric score/grade, or referent needed to identify the question. General factual definitions and fully specified factual questions should proceed to answer. This evaluates routing, not factual answer correctness. A loan-policy answer must not promise actual approval.
